dct_title_s: Damage Assessment in Jindires and the surrounding area, Syria as of 10 February 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code EQ20230206SYR, GDACS Id: 1357372** This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings affected by the 10h of February 2023 earthquake in Jindires and in the surrounding area in Afrin district (Aleppo governorate), Syria as detected from a Pleiades very highresolution satellite image acquired on 10 February 2023. Within the 17 locations (including the city of Jindires), UNOSAT identified 310 damaged structures and 470 potentially damaged. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
